prompt: When every trailer registered on a reply is removed with reply.removeTrailer() before the reply is sent, Fastify still switches the response to trailer mode: it sends Transfer-Encoding: chunked and an empty Trailer header, and drops Content-Length. Fix it so that a reply whose trailers have all been removed behaves exactly as if no trailer had been registered: no Trailer header, no Transfer-Encoding: chunked, a normal Content-Length (5 for the body 'hello'), and no trailer function is called. Removing only some trailers must keep trailer mode for the remaining ones: for example, registering ETag and Content-MD5, removing ETag and sending 'hello' must give a Trailer header of 'content-md5', Transfer-Encoding: chunked, no Content-Length, and the content-md5 trailer value; the removed ETag function is never called.
requirement: At send time, if no registered trailer remains (every one removed), the reply leaves trailer mode: kReplyTrailers is cleared, no Trailer or chunked Transfer-Encoding header is set, Content-Length is computed as usual and no trailer function runs. If at least one remains, Trailer lists the remaining names, Transfer-Encoding is chunked, Content-Length is absent and the remaining trailers are sent; removed trailer functions are never called.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: register an ETag trailer, remove it, send 'hello': status 200, no Trailer header, no Transfer-Encoding, Content-Length '5', no etag trailer, the ETag function never called
register ETag and Content-MD5, remove ETag, send 'hello': Trailer 'content-md5', Transfer-Encoding 'chunked', no Content-Length, trailer content-md5 'custom-md5'; the ETag function never called

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev screen, harder candidates)
provenance.notes: Real defect in fastify v5.11.2 (removing all trailers still forces chunked trailer mode), fixed upstream in 7299a57d (#6845). The reference is that fix applied to v5.11.2; the hidden suite is the upstream remove-all and remove-some tests.
